title: Drive Sales with AI-Generated Product Descriptions in Business Central (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Creating a New Product with Image Analysis
Publishing to Shopify and Business Impact

features.name: Copilot product description generation
features.description: AI-powered feature in Business Central that generates engaging product descriptions using natural language technology, tailored to product data and customizable by attributes and tone.

features.name: Image-based product category suggestion
features.description: Business Central analyzes uploaded product images and suggests appropriate product categories to minimize manual data entry during product registration.

features.name: Attribute-based description customization
features.description: Users can select which product attributes are most relevant for the generated description and choose formatting options for consistency across product lines.

features.name: Tone of voice customization
features.description: Copilot allows users to customize the generated description with different tones of voice to match brand identity and target audience preferences.

features.name: Shopify connector
features.description: First-party connector from Business Central to Shopify e-commerce platform enabling direct publishing of products to online store.
